rows.label: qst620307_msg0001
rows.name: Thanks for that!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0002
rows.name: I think everything's ready now.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0003
rows.name:
A beautiful aurora-lit night, a
Bouquet Stone engagement ring, and
then the proposal...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0004
rows.name: I can only see this succeeding!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0005
rows.name: Then I'll go get Ondina.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0006
rows.name: You really helped me. Thank you!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0007
rows.name: I'm grateful I met you!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0008
rows.name: Yeah... Good luck.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0101
rows.name: I hope it goes well.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0102
rows.name: Yeah.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0103
rows.name:
Even if it ends in disaster, Hana and
the others will pick up the pieces,
mo.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0104
rows.name: Come on now Hana, don't jinx it...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0105
rows.name:
It looks interesting. How about we
secretly watch?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0106
rows.name: Are you for real?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0107
rows.name:
Nia, you are at least a little
interested, right?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0108
rows.name:
Okay, maybe I am...
Just the tiniest bit!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0109
rows.name: I'm very interested.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0110
rows.name:
But won't we be noticed if this whole
crowd stays?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0111
rows.name: You've got a point...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0112
rows.name: Rex, choose.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0113
rows.name: What!?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0114
rows.name: Um...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0115
rows.name: Who will get to watch?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0116
rows.name: Homura

rows.label: qst620307_msg0117
rows.name: Hikari

rows.label: qst620307_msg0118
rows.name: Someone else

rows.label: qst620307_msg0119
rows.name: Nia

rows.label: qst620307_msg0120
rows.name: Hana

rows.label: qst620307_msg0121
rows.name: Kagutsuchi

rows.label: qst620307_msg0122
rows.name: Saika

rows.label: qst620307_msg0123
rows.name: Meleph

rows.label: qst620307_msg0201
rows.name:
I'm so glad everything
worked out for those two.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0202
rows.name:
By lending a hand, we can make someone
happy...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0203
rows.name: That is kind of amazing, right?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0204
rows.name: I really think it does.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0205
rows.name:
Yet another thing Drivers and
Blades can achieve together.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0206
rows.name: We'll have to keep up the good work.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0207
rows.name: For sure!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0301
rows.name:
Not bad. He knows how to deliver when
it counts.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0302
rows.name: I'm glad...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0303
rows.name:
Rex, when are you going to prepare
yours?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0304
rows.name: What?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0305
rows.name: You know what I'm talking about!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0307
rows.name: A Bouquet Stone!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0308
rows.name: Oh...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0309
rows.name: Uhm... Maybe in a little while...?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0310
rows.name:
Or, maybe more like,
a good long while...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0311
rows.name: Rex...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0401
rows.name: Looks like it went well.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0402
rows.name:
No kidding! It feels like
a load off my chest...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0403
rows.name:
Since we couldn't interfere or help,
it was nerve-racking.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0404
rows.name: Yeah...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0405
rows.name:
Nia and I are both the type to act
ourselves. We're not good at leaving
things to others.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0406
rows.name: Yeah.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0407
rows.name:
I don't really see that
changing anytime soon...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0408
rows.name: I think so too.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0501
rows.name: I'm glad everything went well.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0502
rows.name:
I'm disappointed there were no pieces
to pick up, mo...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0503
rows.name: Hey, now.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0504
rows.name: Why did Rex choose Hana to watch, mo?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0505
rows.name: Does Rex have tastes like Master, mo?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0506
rows.name: Nononono, nothing like that!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0507
rows.name:
Hana was born not long ago, right? I
thought this kind of experience might
help you grow.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0508
rows.name:
Ahh. Rex thinks about Hana almost as
much as Master does, mo. Thank you,
mo.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0509
rows.name: ...You're welcome.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0510
rows.name:
Rex... If you do not mind, may Hana
call you Second Master, mo?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0511
rows.name: Second Master!?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0512
rows.name:
N-no... There are all sorts of
problems with that, so let's keep
things as they have been.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0513
rows.name: Is that so, mo?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0601
rows.name: Just as I expected.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0602
rows.name:
You knew the proposal would succeed,
Kagutsuchi?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0603
rows.name: Of course.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0604
rows.name:
You saw how she was at
the harbor, didn't you?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0605
rows.name:
I didn't speak to her face-to-face,
but I could tell roughly what kind of
girl she is.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0606
rows.name:
Leonidas is a little unusual, but his
feelings for her were genuine.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0607
rows.name: The outcome was obvious.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0608
rows.name: Wow...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0609
rows.name:
If someone appears for Meleph someday,
we'll be safe with you around,
Kagutsuchi.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0701
rows.name: What a lovely happy ending.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0702
rows.name: Yeah. I'm glad it worked out!

rows.label: qst620307_msg0703
rows.name:
But things might get really hard from
here, you know?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0704
rows.name: Huh? Really?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0705
rows.name:
Marriage is a bit like the
relationship between a Driver and a
Blade, right?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0706
rows.name:
From now on, Leonidas may get dragged
all over by her once she shows her
true colors.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0707
rows.name: I see...

rows.label: qst620307_msg0708
rows.name:
I'm glad it is Homura and Hikari for
me. They are both kind.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0709
rows.name:
No... As a Driver, you are carrying
the heaviest burden in the world.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0801
rows.name: Looks like it was a success.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0802
rows.name: Yeah... Mission complete.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0803
rows.name:
What did you think of those two,
Meleph?

rows.label: qst620307_msg0804
rows.name:
For their sake too, my resolve to see
our task through has grown even
stronger.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0805
rows.name: Hmm. That's just like you, Meleph.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0806
rows.name:
Our daily battles are for people like
them.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0807
rows.name:
It does not matter whether they are
Invidian or Superbian.

rows.label: qst620307_msg0808
rows.name: Yeah... I need to do my best too.
